bucket stays PUBLIC and every vs-entries public URL still serves (vs-app.js uses getPublicUrl until its change ships)

approval is evaluated live: approve entry 1 as service_role, then anon sees its media

every pack: a SECOND apply on the applied state refuses at the guard (DRIFT, ABORT) and changes nothing

guards ABORT on drift with nothing changed: altered listing policy (P1), extra bucket-wide anon policy (P1), RLS off on profile_content (P4), unexpected ACL (P4), extra SELECT policy (P4), bucket limits already set (P5), SVG-less mime list present in existing objects (P5B), missing is_admin (P1/P4)

recommended order P0,P4,P1,P5,P2,P3a,P3b,[assets moved],P3c,P6 applies end-to-end with every post-check ok; reverse-order rollbacks bring back the original (except the two inert bucket rows); P3b/P3c/P6 refuse without P1; P3c refuses without P3a

P3c refuses while ANY public table still references chat-images (events.cover_url / jsonb / chat message image_url), while public-assets holds fewer than the minimum assets, and passes once references are rewritten to public-assets and the assets exist; the scan returns counts only
pack runs serialise on the repo-wide advisory lock and time out cleanly: while one pack holds the lock a second pack fails with 55P03 after ~5s and changes nothing; once released the second runs
no pack contains a DELETE/TRUNCATE statement or any DML on storage.objects (grep over the generated files, comments stripped)

PRECHECK-17A.sql, the INVENTORY queries, every POSTCHECKS file and the DRIFT_QUERY run READ ONLY (SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY) on the replica and change nothing; the inventory returns names + counts and classifies the synthetic chat-images objects

mutRows.name: P1 mutant: three of the four listing policies dropped, vs_media_read left: caught by behaviour (anon lists vs-entries), by POSTCHECKS(P1 POST) and by DRIFT_QUERY (P1 = DRIFT)
P1 mutant: listing fixed but NO owner SELECT (admin-only replacements): the owner's UPSERT-overwrite breaks (the very flow the path report protects): caught
P1 mutant: a stray bucket-wide anon SELECT policy added back after the fix: caught by DRIFT_QUERY and POSTCHECKS
P4 mutant: 'profile_content read all' dropped, public policy added, NO owner policy: owner cannot UN-ARCHIVE (profile.html Archive list) -> caught
P4 mutant: public policy written 'archived = false': the legacy NULL-archived row disappears from public pages -> caught
P4 mutant: policies fixed but RLS then switched OFF (grants to anon left): anon reads archived rows again -> caught by behaviour, POSTCHECKS(req.rls_on_not_forced) and DRIFT_QUERY
P4 mutant: a permissive 'USING (true)' SELECT policy re-added next to the fix: caught
P3c mutant: chat-images flipped private BEFORE the references were rewritten: caught by the P3c reference scan (a hand-flip leaves references -> POSTCHECKS(P3c) refuse)
P1 mutant: policies fixed but one bucket flipped private by mistake (playlist-covers): public playlist art stops serving -> caught (public URL model + invariant)

adjRows.name: chat-images paths are NOT uid-prefixed in the shipped clients (profiles/<slug>/..., event-flyers/<file>): a uid-only INSERT policy would break both uploads (documented why P3b keeps the two legacy shapes)
storage.objects policies of other buckets (manatua_media_member_read) are byte-identical through every pack (invariant inv.other_policies_md5 enforced inside each pack)
RLS performance shape: owner policies use (SELECT auth.uid()) initPlan form and storage.foldername(name); is_admin() is only evaluated for authenticated (anon policies contain no function calls)
